origin.description: Report whether an object is a warning.
origin.details: True only for a warning condition.
origin.example:
cat("A warning is a warning:", is.warning(simpleWarning("a")), "\n")
cat("A message is not:", is.warning(simpleMessage("a")), "\n")

translation.description: Report whether an object is a warning.
translation.details: True only for a warning condition.
translation.example:
print("A warning is a warning:", is_warning(Warning("a")))
print("A message is not:", is_warning(Message("a")))
